title: Periodic data rigidity for cocycles and hyperbolic automorphisms
summary: We study cohomology of Holder continuous linear cocycles over a hyperbolic dynamical system and regularity of conjugacy between Anosov systems. For cocycles $A$ and $B$ with conjugate periodic data, we establish Holder cohomology under various conditions: the periodic data of $B$ has narrow spectrum and the periodic data conjugacy $C(p)$ is Holder continuous at a periodic point; $B$ is constant and the cocycles are measurably cohomologous; $B$ is constant and diagonalizable over $\mathbb C$ and either its Lyapunov spaces are at most two-dimensional or $C(p)$ is in a bounded set.
